purpose: SHA-256-pinned DUST proving/verifying/parameter assets for local (non-remote) Midnight transaction proving. Only the DUST spend circuit is needed for unshielded NIGHT sends -- shielded (zswap/*) circuits are not bundled since this wallet does not construct shielded transactions.
source: https://midnight-s3-fileshare-dev-eu-west-1.s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com (the same bucket @midnightntwrk/wallet-sdk-prover-client's makeDefaultKeyMaterialProvider fetches live at runtime -- vendored here instead so proving works offline, works in CORS-hostile WebViews, and is integrity-checked rather than trusted on every fetch)
